hunks.baseline: I had no idea. It happened before I was born—or, if you wanted to be technical, back when I was on my father’s side rather than inside my mother’s womb.
hunks.sol: I had no idea. It happened before I was born—or, technically speaking, back when I was still on my father’s side rather than inside my mother’s womb.

hunks.baseline: But those who had stood at the scene of that history must have thought of the countless legends and myths passed down from ancient times.
hunks.sol: But those who witnessed that historic moment must have thought of the countless legends and myths handed down since ancient times.

hunks.baseline: Just as I was now.
hunks.sol: Just as I did now.

hunks.baseline: That was the word that flashed through my mind the instant I saw it. A massive body reaching three meters tall. Bones covered in a black sheen. A shape resembling a human’s, yet fundamentally something else.
hunks.sol: That was the word that flashed through my mind the instant I saw it. A massive body nearly three meters tall. Bones gleaming black. A form resembling a human’s, yet fundamentally something else.

hunks.baseline: Like the wings of a demon from mythology, the robe draped over its body fluttered like a living creature.
hunks.sol: Like the wings of a demon from myth, the robe draped over its body billowed as though it were alive.

hunks.baseline: A demon that darkened the world simply by appearing—or rather, the Arch Lich’s red eyes cast an eerie light.
hunks.sol: The demon’s mere presence darkened the world—or rather, the Arch Lich’s red eyes cast an eerie glow.

hunks.baseline: Just one word.
hunks.sol: One word.

hunks.baseline: The air around me trembled. From inside my inventory, the Skeleton Warlord muttered like a groan.
hunks.sol: The air around me trembled. From inside my Inventory, the Skeleton Warlord muttered with a groan.

hunks.baseline: His voice was steeped in fear. The law of power applied to monsters, too.
hunks.sol: His voice was steeped in fear. The law of the strong applied to monsters, too.

hunks.baseline: Yes. Just as the Skeleton Warlord had said, the Arch Lich was likely the lord of every undead monster in existence.
hunks.sol: Yes. Just as the Skeleton Warlord had said, the Arch Lich was likely the lord of every undead monster in this land.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord was right. It was not too late, and I still had more than enough opportunity left.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord was right. It wasn’t too late. I still had a chance.

hunks.baseline: *An opportunity to stop that bastard, that is.*
hunks.sol: *A chance to stop that bastard.*

hunks.baseline: If this enormous metropolis transformed into a single Gate, there would truly be no turning back.
hunks.sol: If this sprawling metropolis transformed into a single Gate, there would truly be no turning back.

hunks.baseline: *Now or never.*
hunks.sol: *It has to be now.*

hunks.baseline: After taking a deep breath, I extended my hand. The shaft of White Flame, pulled toward me with Seizing an Object Through Empty Space, landed in my grasp.
hunks.sol: I drew a deep breath and extended my hand. White Flame flew toward me through Seizing an Object Through Empty Space, its shaft landing in my grasp.

hunks.baseline: I stepped over the piles of collapsed concrete and trudged outside. A ruined wasteland filled with nothing but thick fog awaited me.
hunks.sol: I stepped over the piles of collapsed concrete and trudged outside. Nothing awaited me but ruins blanketed in thick fog.

hunks.baseline: Up and down. Left and right.
hunks.sol: Above and below. Left and right.

hunks.baseline: No matter where I looked, there was no sign of a monster.
hunks.sol: No matter where I looked, there wasn’t a monster in sight.

hunks.baseline: More than twenty meters above me, the Arch Lich stood on empty air and looked down. Its red eyes gleamed.
hunks.sol: More than twenty meters overhead, the Arch Lich stood upon empty air and gazed down at me. Its red eyes gleamed.

hunks.baseline: “So it’s true. You know the language of the Demon Realm. I did not mishear you.”
hunks.sol: “So it is true. You know the language of the Demon Realm. I did not mishear you.”

hunks.baseline: “I studied hard. But you know me, don’t you?”
hunks.sol: “I studied hard. But you know who I am, don’t you?”

hunks.baseline: “I am an entity with hundreds of eyes and ears. I have watched you all along, human.”
hunks.sol: “I am a being with hundreds of eyes and ears. I have been watching you all along, human.”

hunks.baseline: I muttered inwardly but did not let it show. Instead, I clicked my tongue.
hunks.sol: I kept the thought to myself and clicked my tongue.

hunks.baseline: “True. If you’d seen me through a hidden camera in my bathroom, you would’ve vanished from shock already. No one has ever survived looking my enormous black anaconda in the eye.”
hunks.sol: “True. If you’d watched me in the bathroom, you would’ve vanished from shock already. No one has ever survived looking my enormous black anaconda in the eye.”

hunks.baseline: A Basilisk was a monster from mythology that inflicted a petrification curse simply by making eye contact.
hunks.sol: A Basilisk was a monster from mythology whose gaze inflicted a curse of petrification.

hunks.baseline: At least the part about being so startled that you froze was the same, right?
hunks.sol: At least the part where people froze in shock was the same, right?

hunks.baseline: But the Arch Lich’s response to my answer was unexpected.
hunks.sol: But the Arch Lich’s response was not what I expected.

hunks.baseline: “So that is the reason. The reason you feel strangely familiar to me.”
hunks.sol: “So that is why. Why you feel strangely familiar to me.”

hunks.baseline: “Human. I sense the energy of death from you. A dense, dark energy like my own.”
hunks.sol: “Human. I sense the energy of death upon you. Dense and dark—an energy like my own.”

hunks.baseline: I was secretly startled. I thought I knew what the Arch Lich meant by the energy of death.
hunks.sol: A jolt of surprise ran through me. I thought I knew what the Arch Lich meant by the energy of death.

hunks.baseline: There was someone who could not hide his agitation at every word the creature spoke.
hunks.sol: There was someone who had been unable to hide his agitation at every word the creature spoke.

hunks.baseline: Had the Arch Lich caught the scent that had seeped into my body from spending so much time with him? Or had it seen through even that other unknown space called an inventory?
hunks.sol: Had the Arch Lich caught a scent that had seeped into me after all the time I had spent with him? Or had it seen through even that other unknown space called the Inventory?

hunks.baseline: If the latter was true…
hunks.sol: If it was the latter…

hunks.baseline: *How far do that bastard’s abilities reach?*
hunks.sol: *Just how far do that bastard’s abilities reach?*

hunks.baseline: I activated Qi Sense. Along with a System notification, a blue line shot up into the sky.
hunks.sol: I activated Qi Sense. A blue line shot into the sky along with a System notification.

hunks.baseline: In the next instant, black mana shot from the Arch Lich’s entire body and lashed against the blue line.
hunks.sol: The next instant, black mana erupted from the Arch Lich’s entire body and lashed against the blue line.

hunks.baseline: I’d had a feeling, and sure enough.
hunks.sol: I’d suspected as much, and sure enough.

hunks.baseline: “What an interesting human. Truly. Perhaps… my guess is correct after all.”
hunks.sol: “What an interesting human. Truly. Perhaps… my guess was correct after all.”

hunks.baseline: “What guess? The guess that you’re about to die?”
hunks.sol: “What guess? That you’re about to die?”

hunks.baseline: “That will not happen. I am the lord of all undead. I am different from those weak and foolish humans.”
hunks.sol: “That will not happen. I am the lord of all undead. I am nothing like those weak and foolish humans.”

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich raised a hand made of black, glossy bone and pointed toward Wu Heixing, whose breath had stopped, and Lee Jungryong, who had been reduced to black ash.
hunks.sol: The Arch Lich raised a glossy black hand and pointed at Wu Heixing’s lifeless body, then at the black ashes that had once been Lee Jungryong.

hunks.baseline: “It was a most entertaining sight. Watching you humans kill one another brought me immense joy for the first time in a very long while. I thank you for helping me understand how insignificant humans are.”
hunks.sol: “It was a most entertaining sight. Watching you humans kill one another brought me immense joy for the first time in a very long while. I thank you for helping me understand just how insignificant your kind truly is.”

hunks.baseline: “Get lost.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck off.”

hunks.baseline: The fog filling every direction began to move like a living creature. As though someone were drawing in empty space, it formed a scene and shape.
hunks.sol: The fog filling the area began to move like a living creature. As though an unseen hand were painting upon empty air, it formed a scene before me.

hunks.baseline: A ruined city.
hunks.sol: A city in ruins.

hunks.baseline: At the center of a horrific battlefield where rivers of blood flowed and corpses piled up like mountains, a man was rising with his sword as a cane.
hunks.sol: At the center of a horrific battlefield, where blood flowed in rivers and corpses lay piled like mountains, a man used his sword as a cane to pull himself upright.

hunks.baseline: I had seen his face only once, but I could not forget it.
hunks.sol: I had seen that face only once, but I could never forget it.

hunks.baseline: “Lei Fei. That was certainly his name.”
hunks.sol: “Lei Fei. That was his name.”

hunks.baseline: “He possessed a great, radiant soul. He was so dazzling that I coveted him simply by watching from afar.”
hunks.sol: “He possessed a great and radiant soul. So dazzling that I coveted him merely from watching afar.”

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei glaring at the sky with a face filled with rage and resentment as he breathed his last.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei glaring at the sky, his face filled with rage and anguish, as he breathed his last.

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei reborn as a corrupted being by the Arch Lich, kneeling before his new master.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei reborn as a corrupted being through the Arch Lich’s power, kneeling before his new master.

hunks.baseline: “Do you know? Humans with noble souls wield even greater power after they fall. He truly was the finest material… It was unfortunate, but he did not turn out so badly.”
hunks.sol: “Did you know? Humans with noble souls wield even greater power once they fall. He truly was the finest material… The outcome was regrettable, but he did not turn out too badly.”

hunks.baseline: “I have found new material. You, human—with an even stronger and more massive soul!”
hunks.sol: “For I have found new material. You, human—with an even stronger and greater soul!”

hunks.baseline: The chilling voice thundered through the air.
hunks.sol: Its chilling voice thundered through the air.

hunks.baseline: Mana flowed from the Arch Lich’s entire body, covering the sky like dark storm clouds and staining the city in darkness.
hunks.sol: Mana poured from the Arch Lich’s entire body, covering the sky like dark storm clouds and casting the city into darkness.

hunks.baseline: I stood silently and watched the scene. Then I suddenly opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I watched in silence for a moment, then opened my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah, so… are you done talking now?”
hunks.sol: “Right, so… are you finally done running your mouth?”

hunks.baseline: My stomach was burning.
hunks.sol: My stomach burned.

hunks.baseline: The anger I had been storing up and suppressing until I met the Arch Lich was rising to the surface.
hunks.sol: The rage I had stored up and suppressed until I met the Arch Lich reared its head.

hunks.baseline: It surged like lava in a volcanic region.
hunks.sol: It surged like lava from a volcanic field.

hunks.baseline: Something snapped in my head.
hunks.sol: Something snapped inside my head.

hunks.baseline: The hours of battle I had endured while leading the suicide squad, along with the mental fatigue that had built up while fighting Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing, vanished from my mind in that instant.
hunks.sol: For that moment, I forgot even the mental exhaustion from hours of fighting at the head of the suicide squad and my battles against Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing.

hunks.baseline: If the Arch Lich’s voice had been thunder, my shout was lava.
hunks.sol: If the Arch Lich’s voice was thunder, my shout was lava.

hunks.baseline: A fire dragon raced along the hundreds of acupoints boiling like an active volcano. Blue flames covered White Flame’s transparent spearhead, radiating heat of unimaginable intensity.
hunks.sol: The fire dragon raced through hundreds of acupoints boiling like an active volcano. Blue flames engulfed White Flame’s transparent spearhead, radiating tremendous heat.

hunks.baseline: The spear of flame I launched with all my strength blew apart the dark clouds of mana and tore through the darkness.
hunks.sol: The spear of fire I hurled with all my strength burst through the dark clouds of mana and tore the darkness apart.

hunks.baseline: Along with a vibration that shook the earth, dazzling blue flames spread across the sky.
hunks.sol: The earth shook as dazzling blue flames painted the sky.

hunks.baseline: Several kilometers away, the humans and monsters locked in a fierce battle momentarily forgot even their own circumstances and stared blankly at the spectacle.
hunks.sol: Several kilometers away, the humans and monsters locked in fierce battle forgot their own circumstances for a moment and stared blankly at the spectacle.

hunks.baseline: The light that burst from the enormous city shrouded in thick fog was warmer and more dazzling than anything else.
hunks.sol: The light bursting from the enormous city shrouded in thick fog was warmer and more dazzling than anything else.

hunks.baseline: There was no one else it could be.
hunks.sol: It was him. It had to be.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung was alive, and he was fighting the Arch Lich.
hunks.sol: No one but Jin Taekyung came to mind. He was alive, and he was fighting the Arch Lich.

hunks.baseline: No. Perhaps he was fighting someone else, too.
hunks.sol: No. Perhaps someone else as well.

hunks.baseline: Others might call his concern premature and his suspicions a false accusation, but Choi Minwoo knew how evil a person could become.
hunks.sol: Others might dismiss his concern as premature and his suspicions as baseless accusations, but Choi Minwoo knew how evil a person could become.

hunks.baseline: At least, that was what the Lee Jungryong he had known had been like.
hunks.sol: At least, the Lee Jungryong he had known was capable of such evil.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo had said those words to Jin Taekyung once.
hunks.sol: He had once said those words to Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: Some people might have laughed at him, but Choi Minwoo had been sincere.
hunks.sol: Some people might have laughed at him, but Choi Minwoo had meant them.

hunks.baseline: He believed that no S-rank Hunter—not even Cheon Taemin, his maternal grandfather and the man who had defeated the Demon King Asmodeus—could be stronger than Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: He believed no S-rank Hunter—not even Cheon Taemin, his maternal grandfather and the man who had defeated the Demon King Asmodeus—could be stronger than Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: It was not a matter of skill. Nor was it even a question of whose aura was greater or stronger.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t a matter of skill, much less a question of whose aura was greater or stronger.

hunks.baseline: It was something possessed only by those who had experienced Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: It was something only those who had come to know Jin Taekyung possessed.

hunks.baseline: Cheon Taemin, the hero who had saved humanity, had turned away from his young grandson after the boy lost his parents.
hunks.sol: Cheon Taemin, the hero who had saved humanity, had pushed his young grandson out of his thoughts after the boy lost his parents.

hunks.baseline: He had rejected the temptations around him that whispered of wealth and honor, remained with the Peace Guild, and protected his people no matter what danger they faced.
hunks.sol: He had rejected every temptation around him that whispered of wealth and honor, remained with the Peace Guild, and protected his people through every danger.

hunks.sol: *“Thorny roads are kind of my specialty.”*

hunks.baseline: *“A road more dangerous than anything we’ve faced so far.”*
hunks.sol: *“More dangerous than anything we’ve faced so far.”*

hunks.sol: *“Team Leader Choi.”*

hunks.baseline: It was the first time.
hunks.sol: It was the first time anyone had ever said that to him.

hunks.baseline: No one had ever said anything like that to him before.
Butler Kim, who had always been by his side since childhood, was thoughtful and warm, but he had never given Choi Minwoo that certainty.

hunks.baseline: *So this is what it was.*
hunks.sol: *So this is what it feels like.*

hunks.sol: For as long as he could remember, he had been cut off from everything around him.

hunks.baseline: The children he met as a boy were wary of him, and the adults whispered among themselves.
hunks.sol: The children he met in his youth were wary of him, and the adults whispered among themselves.

hunks.baseline: He had been hurt, but he never let it show. Only the aging Butler Kim had been someone he could truly confide in.
hunks.sol: It hurt, but he never let it show. Only the aging Butler Kim had ever been someone he could truly confide in.

hunks.sol: A smile appeared on Choi Minwoo’s lips.

hunks.baseline: Far in the distance, he watched the flames rising through the thick fog and darkness, then gripped his sword once more.
hunks.sol: Watching the flames rise through the distant fog and darkness, he tightened his grip on his sword.

hunks.baseline: As the brief silence and stillness that had settled over the battlefield shattered, a tremendous cry burst from Choi Minwoo’s lips.
hunks.sol: The brief silence that had fallen over the battlefield shattered, and a tremendous cry burst from Choi Minwoo’s lips.

hunks.baseline: Raising his sword and charging toward the monsters, he resembled someone Lee Jungryong had seen several decades ago.
hunks.sol: He raised his sword and charged toward the monsters, looking much like someone Lee Jungryong had seen several decades ago.
